title: ERPNext 15 sales invoice, Sales Invoice Print format, 32 lines, repeated letter head, A4, 3 pages
notes: Sales Invoice ACC-SINV-2026-00002, submitted (Unpaid), posting date 2026-10-23, due 2026-12-31, customer Hôtel-Restaurant Le Cèdre, customer PO CEDRE-2026-118 of 2026-10-09, 32 lines (every CER- item of the catalogue), net 11 548.80 EUR, VAT 20 % 2 309.76, total 13 858.56, terms "Conditions générales de vente". Print Settings: the defaults (print style Redesign, font Default, PDF page size A4, Repeat Header and Footer on, Compact Item Print off, with letter head). Letter Head Atelier Kiln (the default one of `erpnext15-sales-invoice`): HTML header (logo `/files/atelier-kiln-logo.png` and company address) and HTML footer (legal mentions, bank details). Captured from Frappe 15.124.0 (commit f1cf50cf9bbc) + ERPNext 15.124.1 (commit 4e0dce9ea8d3), printed through HTTP /api/method/frappe.utils.print_format.download_pdf with a logged-in session, as the print view's PDF button does. Frappe (pdfkit 1.0.0) pipes the page on stdin and reads the PDF from stdout: `-` `-` at the end; the output `-` is replaced by {out}. Frappe passed `--cookie-jar /tmp/<random>.jar` (session cookie sid); that pair is removed. /tmp/frappe-pdf-<random>.html header and footer files became input/header.html and input/footer.html. No margin-top or margin-bottom is passed: the header and footer heights decide the margins. The footer page inlines the whole print CSS; the header page links it. JavaScript is disabled for the page but the footer's subst() still fills the page numbers. Origin http://127.0.0.1:8000 rewritten to http://127.0.0.1:8765 in input/page.html, input/header.html (no www/ file contained it). www lists the entry's own files (if any) then corpus/_shared/erpnext15/www (print CSS print.bundle.7DKZWKDD.css, same content as H34JAH53 of the first two ERPNext entries but for three comments, and the Atelier Kiln logo). httpHeaders are the Cache-Control values the Frappe server sent. The print CSS has no @font-face: the text relies on fonts installed on the machine. ERPNext parts are GPL-3.0; Frappe parts are MIT; the print CSS also bundles Bootstrap 3.3.1, normalize.css and HTML5 Boilerplate (MIT) and Quill 2.0.3 CSS (BSD-3-Clause); letter heads, images and business data were written for the corpus. See SOURCE.md.
